claim_legs.durability: Prospective source pins and exact predecessor inputs bind first-run outputs. Complete exact recovery copies and saved-only audit/recovery pass without raw-log access or any fixture replay. Exact completed task subtrees and prior acceptance histories remain Git-retrievable; book and Knowledge Map route the frontier.
claim_legs.falsify: Separate lifetime intervals and original call/single-close source-scope interpreters reproduce winners, cleanup and effects across input-order permutations. Altered-domain and book count/redistribution controls reject wrong coverage, primaries, order, closure and effects.
claim_legs.rederive: Current healthy events and source-owned cleanup bindings derive the finite recipes and report sets. The book watcher independently recounts saved categories.

commit_gate: Staged doctrines and normal commit hooks must pass before commit.
limits: Actual composition execution is owned by the profile children. Full close-report join, genuine omissions, final release, native/lifetime and historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain open.
scope: Prospective bounded release error compositions; no actual file fixture or read/close report executes.
